mapper.sql: SELECT file_id, file_no, file_name, file_category, product_id, product_code, product_name, scheme_id, scheme_no, file_url, file_status, dept_id, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM pdm_design_file
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pdm_design_file (file_no, file_name, file_category, product_id, product_code, product_name, scheme_id, scheme_no, file_url, file_status, dept_id, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{fileNo}, #{fileName}, #{fileCategory}, #{productId}, #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{schemeId}, #{schemeNo}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileStatus}, #{deptId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: UPDATE pdm_design_file SET del_flag = '2' WHERE file_id IN #{fileId}
